tasks.title: Announcement #16
tasks.instruction: Listen to a librarian talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: Hello, I'm the librarian. We use an electronic control system here, which means you need to register on the computer before you borrow any books. So please do remember to bring your ID card here whenever you want to borrow some books. Besides, we accept online reservation on books so you could simply reserve the book you need wherever you have access to our school website. If you have any question, find me at work hours at the front desk.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the talk?

options.A: To introduce a newly completed system
options.B: To explain how to use the library
options.C: To show an example of how to use ID card
options.D: To tell students where to find the librarian

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段讲话的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住图书管理员整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 图书管理员提到使用电子控制系统，但并未说明这是新完成的系统，只是说明现有借阅规则。 选项B：正确。 图书管理员说明了借书前需要在电脑上注册、需要带身份证、可以网上预约、有问题可到前台找她，整段话的目的是解释如何使用图书馆。 选项C：错误。 讲话中提到使用身份证，但并非展示具体使用示例，只是告知需要携带。 选项D：错误。 讲话末尾提到可以在前台找到图书管理员，但这只是讲话中的一个小信息，并非主要目的。

questions.stem: What is true about the library?

options.A: Students can only borrow books after reservation on the computer.
options.B: Students can not reserve books outside school.
options.C: Students need ID cards to make registration.
options.D: Students can only borrow books after registration on computer.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于图书馆哪项是正确的，属于细节理解题，需抓住图书管理员对图书馆规则的明确说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 图书管理员说“you need to register on the computer before you borrow any books”，但并未说明借书前还需要在网上预约，预约是针对特定书籍的附加服务。 选项B：错误。 图书管理员说“wherever you have access to our school website”，并未限制只能在校内预约，只要能访问学校网站即可。 选项C：错误。 图书管理员说“bring your ID card here whenever you want to borrow some books”，身份证是借书时需要携带的，而非用来注册的。注册需要用电脑完成。 选项D：正确。 图书管理员明确说“you need to register on the computer before you borrow any books”，即学生必须在电脑上注册后才能借书。
